text:
kia_support: customer hit duplicate charges. they said SDK v1.13.0 retried a POST after a 2s timeout. attaching tiny repro.

lee_py_sdk: repro quick check: async client timed out then our retry kicked in and re-sent payload. we should only replay when idempotency_key is supplied.

noah_types: also noticed typing gaps: post(...) has no idempotency_key param in stubs, so users don't discover best practice. propose adding idempotency_key: Optional[str] and buffer_retries: bool in signatures.

sam_runtime: root cause: our replayability test uses hasattr(body,'seek') which misclassifies some wrapper objects as seekable. fix: attempt tell/seek inside try/catch. Also default retry policy should be stricter: for POST/PUT/PATCH, do not retry on timeout/5xx unless idempotency_key present.

kia_support: customer wants guidance. what's the mitigation?

lee_py_sdk: quick mitigation: publish 1.13.1 that disables non-idempotent retries by default and emits sdk.request.replay_blocked metric. Add migration note: callers wanting old behavior can set buffer_retries=True or pass idempotency_key.

ops_bot: ticket created #4712 "py-sdk: tighten replay checks, add idempotency_key param and buffer_retries".

sam_runtime: tests to add: generator body -> no retry; file-like that raises on seek -> no retry; idempotency_key present -> allowed retry with exponential backoff 100-1600ms.

noah_types: i'll open a types PR and update stubs/docs.

lee_py_sdk: will send small PR with runtime fix + metrics + changelog entry. merging after review.

kia_support: thanks, pls loop me in before customer outreach.
